reason: My udhaar diary has worked for years and I trust it more than any phone. I don't want my customers' khata sitting inside a WhatsApp bot, and a free 3 months only means I get used to it before the bill starts.
objection: If I move my udhaar into this and it makes a mistake or stops working, I lose the records I run my business on. And what happens after the 3 months, when I'm already dependent on it?
would_change_my_mind: A person from the company sits in my shop for a few weeks and runs it alongside my diary, so I can check every entry against the diary. I also need a written promise that I can export my khata and that the price stays fixed after the free months.
